prompt:
Portrait 390×844 mobile web app screen for「台灣停車預測」, a working parking map for a driver arriving at「新莊體育館」. Show the complete first screen edge to edge: compact destination search and map actions, a large street map with individually tappable roadside spaces, a clearly different off-street garage icon, selected-space detail, nearby comparison rows, then familiar bottom navigation. No device or browser frame.
Let a rigorous geometric map grid lead. Give each roadside space a compact fixed shape with a clear number and distinct status symbol, keeping those markers on the actual street edges. Select「正中路 25 號」. Its information grid must plainly separate「目前觀測：有位」「資料品質：可用」「一般汽車適用性：已確認」「官方觀測時間：未提供」「系統取得：10:28」「收費：20 元／小時」「抵達預測：資料不足」. Show occupied and unknown examples beside it; use symbol, label and color together. The first rows below compare other spaces and one distinct parking lot.
Visual voice: warm white, deep navy ink, disciplined geometric alignment, restrained coral red and golden yellow, clean grid lines, crisp large Chinese text. Strong spacing keeps the street map useful, and the detail fields remain scan-friendly. Put「合成示意資料，非即時資訊」on the screen. Avoid naming any government data provider, implying a live official reading, or inventing a prediction, probability, route or ETA. No technical dashboard charts; this is a calm, familiar consumer map screen.
